title: Soviet Phobos probe's last image before shutdown

tellings.quote:
The last image shows an object like
a fin on the tail of a plane, it
looks like it's in the photo.

plain: In 1989 a Soviet probe sent to Phobos, one of the moons of Mars, stopped working, and its last image is said to show a strange object. Michels describes it himself, without naming a source: "an object like a fin on the tail of a plane." He raises it in an episode about claims that NASA hides unusual space data, as a hint that something was out there near Mars.
